notes.title: If an NPC hates you in this adventure from the makers of Road 96, it's probably because another player was mean to them earlier
notes.notes: "We should make Road 96 but with boats! Boat 96!" joked the developers at Digixart when planning their follow up to their excellent procedural road trip, Road 96. And their next game does indeed have a lot of boats—but it's also a pretty big departure from their previous game... Read more.

notes.title: 🌊 Tides of Tomorrow has a release date!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey Tiderwalkers![/h3]

Today at State of Play, we announced the release date for Tides of Tomorrow! 

A new adventure with an innovative multiplayer influence system, that will arrive on February 24th 2026 for Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 and PC. 

[previewyoutube=43RMfZzY-M4;full][/previewyoutube]
Hope this trailer answers more questions than the first one! 😀 

Tides of Tomorrow will take you to an oceanic planet, where life is facing extinction from a deadly disease. You must find a cure to survive but you don’t have to do it alone, so will you choose to help your fellow Tidewalkers?


[h3]A Multiplayer Experience![/h3]

Every choice matters! Our multiplayer influence system crafts your experience based on other players! 

Each person who plays is recorded, their choices are saved, and you can follow them along your journey! A friend? A streamer? The choice is yours! 

You will feel the impact from the consequences of the one you follow and must deal with them! It’s up to you to cooperate... or to make some waves!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050910/55f9b548115b923b5f5d98588df3dfa47592e6f8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Join us on this Adventure![/h3]
We are Digixart, the studio behind Road 96! The whole team has put their heart and souls into making this game an incredible and unique experience. 

We’ll be regularly updating our social media and discussing with you on [url=https://discord.com/invite/TxZQaAPczK]Discord[/url] about the game and the team to take you behind the scenes of development! 

We can’t wait to share more with you so don’t forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2678080/Tides_of_Tomorrow/]wishlist[/url] the game and follow us on all our socials and take a look at [url=https://tidesoftomorrow.com/]our website[/url].

notes.title: 🌊 Join us on the Waters of Elynd
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey Tiders![/h3]

We are thrilled to invite you to dive into Elynd, the world of Tides of Tomorrow! This isn’t just any game—it's an adventure shaped by you, your friends, and your favorite streamers. Elynd is an oceanic world fighting for survival after the Great Flood, and we can't wait for you to be part of this epic journey.

[previewyoutube=yVjNGNZcqHQ;full][/previewyoutube]
In Tides of Tomorrow your every choice matters. A deadly plastification is slowly killing all life, and it's up to you to find a cure, explore floating platforms, and navigate through various communities. But you won’t be alone! Your friends' and other players' decisions will directly impact your story, adding a thrilling layer of unpredictability.

[h5]Here’s what you can look forward to:[/h5]

[quote=author] [b]🌊 Follow Friends & Streamers: [/b]Stay connected and see how their adventures influence your own. Share tips, strategies, and experiences to help each other out.

[b]⛵ Sail Through Dangerous Waters: [/b]Brave the open seas and face the challenges of this beautiful yet dangerous world together.

[b]🛠️ Resource Gathering: [/b]Collect and manage resources. Every bit helps in improving your chances of survival and impacts the setting.

[b]🏝️ Explore Floating Platforms: [/b]Discover stunning and diverse landscapes. Each platform holds secrets and surprises waiting to be uncovered.

[b]👥 Meet Unforgettable Characters:[/b] Encounter a cast of unique characters. Your decisions will shape your relationships, turning allies into enemies and vice versa. [/quote] 

We are incredibly excited to build this community with you. Elynd is more than just a game—it's a shared adventure. We encourage you to join our discussions, share your stories, and help each other navigate the challenges ahead.

[i][h5]Are you ready to embark on this journey? Dive into the waters of Elynd on Steam and let’s shape the future of this oceanic world together! 🌍💧[/h5][/i]
[i][h3]See you in Elynd![/h3][/i][h3]Your DigixArt Studio[/h3]
